title: VoCo: A Simple-yet-Effective Volume Contrastive Learning Framework for 3D Medical Image Analysis
caption: Figure 2. Typical contrastive learning frameworks. (a) Instance-level contrastive learning [10, 11, 29, 22, 7] employs strong data augmentation or model perturbation on input data to acquire different views of instance, then regularizes their consistency. (b) Prototype- level contrastive learning [5, 6, 56, 45, 15, 16] conducts (1) online clustering or (2) randomly initialize then online update process to obtain prototypes as class assignments, then leverage the prototypes to contrast each input image. (c) Our VoCo follows the idea of prototype-level contrastive learning. Specifically, instead of using time-consuming online clustering and updating procedures, we leverage the valuable contextual position priors of 3D medical images and leverage the base crops to generate prototypes (bases).
